The a=±b case gives fixed or one antisymmetric primitive cycle; the other case ab=-c(1+nu3) and the positive-root discriminant proves exactly two additional reflected cycles, with collision at the threshold; no other real cases. Independently checked the exact rational witness (nu1,nu3,nu2)=(1/2,1/2,25/24), (a,b)=(1,-3/4), and derived amplitude and threshold comparisons. This does not establish higher-period dynamics or stability.
